name: dandb-static-site
description: Serves the same static files as Cloudflare (root index.html, /services, /locations).

scripts.build: npm run build:css && node scripts/generate-blog-static.mjs && node scripts/generate-sitemap.mjs && node scripts/sync-dist.mjs
scripts.verify:functions: npm run build && npx wrangler pages functions build functions --build-output-directory dist
scripts.dev:pages: npm run build && npx wrangler pages dev dist --port 8788
scripts.deploy:pages: npm run build && npx wrangler pages deploy dist --branch main --commit-dirty=true && node scripts/deploy-note.mjs
